root_cause.explanation: Version v5.2.0 (deploy-001) changed customer_ref from a string to a struct, and from 08:12 every batch is rejected with a schema mismatch (log-002). Batches are arriving and queueing in the dead-letter queue (log-006), so upstream volume has not dropped. No metric series exist for this service, so the diagnosis rests on logs and the deploy record.

remediation.reason: Rolling back to v5.1.4 restores the string column the downstream readers expect; the rejected batches stay in the dead-letter queue for replay.
remediation.rollback: Redeploy v5.2.0 once the downstream readers handle the struct column.

postmortem.summary: Version v5.2.0 changed customer_ref from a string to a struct, and every ingestion batch was rejected with a schema mismatch. Rolling back to v5.1.4 let batches through again.
timeline: Version v5.2.0 deployed with customer_ref as a struct (deploy-001).
From 08:12 every batch is rejected with a schema mismatch (log-002).
The deployment was rolled back to v5.1.4 after operator approval and the symptoms cleared.
